To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a simple, rapid and reproducible procedure for the simultaneous measurement of neurotrophic factor mRNA levels in brain and peripheral tissue samples.
we have developed a simple, reproducible and rapid method, based upon RT-PCR followed by a ELISA detection system to analyze the levels of NGF and of BDNF mRNA in brain and peripheral tissue.

we describe a novel and simple method for measurement of neurotrofins mRNA levels, that could be used in studies of the expression of molecules involved into the pathogenesis of different diseases, such as neurodegenerative diseases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a rapid and reproducible RT-PCR ELISAs method for the measurement of neurotrophic factors mRNA expression in brain, spinal cord and peripheral tissues.
the development of a rapid and simple RT-PCR ELISAs for the measurement of neurotrophic factors and cytokine mRNAs in brain and peripheral organs.
the development of a new method to study neurotrophin and cytokine expression in brain and periphereal tissues.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the RT-PCR ELISAs developed in this work could represent a useful tool for the analysis of the expression pattern of a large variety of mRNAs in brain and peripheral organs, including those involved in neurodegenerative diseases.
this RT-PCR/ELISA method represents a simple and sensitive procedure to measure neurotrophin and other molecules mRNA expression in different brain and peripheral tissues.
this procedure could be used as a useful and rapid method to measure the expression of different genes in different tissues and to study their role in physiological and pathological conditions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a simple and rapid method for the detection of neurotrophins mRNA expression in brain, spinal cord and peripheral tissues.
we have developed a new, rapid and simple method for measuring mRNA expression of NGF and of BDNF in brain and peripheral tissue, which can be easily applied to other molecules.
the RT-PCR ELISAs described in the present study are simple and rapid procedures to detect and quantify mRNA expression levels of different molecules in a variety of tissues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RT-PCR ELISAs can be used to study the expression of multiple mRNA species in a single experiment, and the method is simple to implement, and can be used in many different laboratories.
RT-PCR ELIZA method is a simple and reliable technique to evaluate the mRNA expression of neurotrophic factors and neuropeptides.
the procedure described here is a simple, fast, and sensitive method for the measurement of neurotrophic factor mRNAs expression and could be useful for a large number of studies in neuroscience.
